The Thorpy Fallout Cloud is a very impressive development of one of the world’s most popular fuzz pedals: the Triangle Big Muff. The Fallout Cloud adds a powerful tone control to this overwhelming, wall-of-sound fuzz, giving the pedal a whole new dimension and flexibility. Thanks to a number of ingenious adjustments, the Fallout Cloud works smoothly with any guitar, whether you use single coils, humbuckers or p90 pickups! Like every Thorpy pedal, the Fallout Cloud is built like a tank, with Neutrik Jacks and an indestructible chassis. sources.excerpt: The Fallout Cloud Fuzz by ThorpyFX | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE ThorpyFX The Fallout Cloud Fuzz LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description I was asked to create the FALLOUT CLOUD by a number of vintage pedal enthusiasts I know. They were after a Triangle era style pedal that would work with a variety of guitars (Humbucker and singlecoil's including P90's) and amps and be bombproof so it could be gigged. The brief was simple, make a triangle era Fuzz that could beat their original 1971 Triangle fuzz pedals when placed head to head. Internally the pedal is immaculately built using premium 1% metalfilm resistors, Wima and Panasonic capacitors, and Neutrik jacks. These are the crème de la crème of the electronics world and when coupled with a robust gold plated PCB and dust sealed potentiometers the recipe is as good as it can possibly be.
